Container.Name: NoBookEnds-Sync
Container.Overview: Exact sync for Listen & Read in the NoBookEnds app. Runs next to Audiobookshelf, transcribes each audiobook once with faster-whisper and aligns it to the matching EPUB, so the app can highlight the sentence and word being read. Optional: NoBookEnds works without it.[br][br]This template uses the CPU image (:cpu), which runs on any server without a GPU. It is several times slower than an NVIDIA GPU, which is why automatic work waits for the overnight window. With an NVIDIA GPU and the Nvidia Driver plugin, use the GPU template instead.[br][br]Automatic alignments of your existing library only run overnight (Auto window, default 01:00-06:00 in the server time zone). Books a reader asks for in the app start right away.[br][br]Give it a public HTTPS address such as booksync.yourdomain.com through your reverse proxy so phones can reach it. Everything stays on your server.

Config.Name: WebUI / API port
Config.Description: HTTP API port. Point your reverse proxy (for example booksync.yourdomain.com) at it.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, alignment results, cached transcripts and whisper models (a few GB for a large library).

Config.Name: Audiobookshelf URL
Config.Description: Audiobookshelf as seen from this container: your server IP and the Audiobookshelf port (for example http://192.168.1.10:13378), or http://audiobookshelf:80 when both containers share a custom Docker network.

Config.Name: Audiobookshelf API key
Config.Description: API key of a dedicated Audiobookshelf user that can download but not upload, update or delete, with access to all libraries (see the README).

Config.Name: Admin token
Config.Description: Long random secret that enables the admin API (used by AllSeerr Settings > Services). Leave empty to disable the admin API.

Config.Name: Auto window
Config.Description: Local time window for automatic alignments of your library, for example 01:00-06:00 or 22:30-05:00. Use always to run them at any time. Books readers ask for are never held back.

Config.Name: Auto mode
Config.Description: Find audiobook and EPUB pairs in Audiobookshelf and align them automatically (inside the auto window). false: only align books readers ask for.

Config.Name: Whisper model
Config.Description: small.en is a good balance. base.en is about twice as fast; medium.en is slower and more accurate on difficult audio. Use small or medium (without .en) for books not in English.

Config.Name: Whisper language
Config.Description: Language code for multilingual models (ignored by .en models).

Config.Name: CPU threads
Config.Description: Threads for transcription. auto uses half of the CPUs (about one per physical core), at most 16, or the --cpus limit when you set one in Extra Parameters.
